what: An analyst who sets Summary to This month (or to custom dates), opens a trial from it and presses "‹ Back to <watchlist>" lands on Summary showing This week, so the period they chose is lost. Before this build the same click kept the period, because the page remembered the whole Summary address. The trial link now carries only from=summary, and the Back link is built from it alone. The spec leaves the period out of the trial address, so it may accept losing it after a reload, but nothing in it asks to lose it within one page load. To see it: Summary, This month, open a trial heading, press Back to.

A trial address edited by hand to list=abc, list=0 or an empty list= opens the trial with its first watchlist, as it should, but the address keeps the bad value, while list=99 is rewritten to name the watchlist shown. The spec asks that the address never claim a watchlist the page is not using. I am not sure this counts, because list=abc names no watchlist at all. The cause: such a value is read as no watchlist, and only a watchlist number that does not hold the trial is rewritten. To see it: open #/trials/NCT03412565?list=abc and look at the address.
